authorization.basis: Explicit instruction in the current repository task to freeze the PRD, System Design, and API documentation

frozen_decisions: Refresh completion, partial failure, retry, and ownership remain explicit
Index generations are immutable, complete, verified, and activated by compare-and-swap
Every read request pins one active generation and fails closed when corpus proof is unavailable
Material answer claims require citations to server-owned evidence
The v1 public interface is the documented MCP and Python contract
Local verification does not prove external deployment or production readiness

requires_prd_reopen_or_superseding_versi: Change to refresh terminal or retry semantics
Change to generation completeness, activation, rollback, or request-pinning semantics
Breaking v1 request or response change
Relaxation of fail-closed, citation, secret-handling, or deployment-proof boundaries

proof_boundary: This manifest freezes repository documentation semantics and verifies the listed file bytes. It does not commit the files to Git, execute CI, deploy a service, authorize production traffic, or prove external-provider behavior.
